semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company manufactures magnetic components that are integral to various semiconductor applications.
summary: Shaanxi Shinhom Enterprise Co., Ltd specializes in manufacturing a diverse range of magnetic components, including inductors and transformers, which are essential for semiconductor applications. With over 35 years of experience, they offer custom design and manufacturing capabilities, supporting a wide array of semiconductor-related products.

regional_presence.China: Operates four modern factories with a significant workforce, producing over 200 million units annually.
